ch0286_80_svboy/0101_0701_01_10:
Hi, [Name:PlayerNickname ]! Let’s enjoy
a festival together!
ch0286_80_svboy/0101_0701_02_10:
If you listen carefully, don’t you hear a
festival?
ch0286_80_svboy/7101_0701_01_10:
There’s a candy fruit stand at the Festival of
Masks in Kitakami.
ch0286_80_svboy/7101_0701_02_10:
The Candy Rawst Berries sold there are...
um...something else.
ch0286_80_svboy/7101_0701_03_10:
They’re extremely bitter. I ate a candy apple
to get rid of the taste.
ch0286_80_svboy/7101_0701_04_10: Wait...was that the stand’s plan all along?
ch0286_80_svboy/7102_0701_01_10:
Yanmega are super strong! Apparently,
they can easily transport an adult in flight.
ch0286_80_svboy/7102_0701_02_10:
Just goes to show how powerful their
wingbeats are! They’re even reliable in
Pokémon battles!
ch0286_80_svboy/7103_0701_01_10: Wearing a jinbei puts me in a festival mood!
ch0286_80_svboy/7103_0701_02_10:
Whenever I hear festive drumbeats, I can’t
help but dance!
ch0286_80_svboy/7104_0701_01_10:
If you ever go to the Festival of Masks, you
should take on the Ogre Oustin’ challenge!
ch0286_80_svboy/7104_0701_02_10:
It’s score-based, so it’s exciting to play with
friends!
ch0286_80_svboy/7104_0701_03_10:
Think you can beat my score,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]?
ch0286_80_svboy/7105_0701_01_10:
[Name:PlayerNickname ], do you wear
anything special for festivals?
ch0286_80_svboy/7105_0701_02_10:
Learning what makes each region’s festivals
and clothes unique sounds fun, doesn’t it?!
ch0286_80_svboy/1701_0702_01_10:
I hope I can support you as you try new
things!
ch0286_80_svboy/2501_0701_01_10: Did my jinbei’s design catch your eye?
ch0286_80_svboy/2501_0701_02_10:
I think these are the three Pokémon once said
to be the heroes of Kitakami.
ch0286_80_svboy/2501_0701_03_10: Huh? You want to know more about them?
ch0286_80_svboy/2501_0701_04_10: Hmm. I don’t know where to start.
ch0286_80_svboy/2501_0702_01_10:
Although the legends passed down in the
village weren’t actually true...
ch0286_80_svboy/2501_0702_02_10:
I’m sure the Festival of Masks’ fun vibes will
never change!
ch0286_80_svboy/2511_0701_01_10:
Festivals are great opportunities to learn
about the regions they’re held in.
ch0286_80_svboy/2511_0701_02_10:
Don’t just have fun. Pay attention to how it
all came to be!
ch0286_80_svboy/2511_0701_03_10:
Unraveling history and culture might even
lead to uncovering amazing Pokémon!
ch0286_80_svboy/2511_0702_01_10:
Here on Pasio, I heard a place called
Jubilife Village used to hold festivals back
in the Hisuian era!
ch0286_80_svboy/2511_0702_02_10:
Do you think those festivals were passed
down and still exist in Sinnoh, the region
Hisui came to be?
ch0286_80_svboy/3001_0701_01_10:
I was so excited for the festival, I woke up
early! Did you do the same?
ch0286_80_svboy/3003_0701_01_10:
One of the best things about festivals is
the stalls! I wonder what kinds will be at
this one...
ch0286_80_svboy/3005_0701_01_10:
The real festival starts when it’s dark.
Don’t get lost!
